articles.title: Fidelity joins push for Senate passage of CLARITY Act
articles.snippet: Fidelity called on the US Senate to pass the CLARITY Act, joining industry groups and crypto firms pushing for market structure legislation.

articles.title: BTC supply in profit eyes 60%, but analysis hints recovery may ‘roll back over’
articles.snippet: Bitcoin supply profitability improved versus its 2026 low, but analysis warned that a fake recovery had already broken down at the start of June.

articles.title: Dem senator calls GOP’s CLARITY ethics proposal a ‘piece of s---’: Politico
articles.snippet: On Wednesday, Senate Republicans released the proposed text for the CLARITY Act, which has been met with pushback from Democrats regarding ethics provisions.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs Shed $225M, Snapping Seven-Day Inflow Streak as Iran Tensions Spook Markets
articles.snippet: BlackRock's IBIT led the exit as Bitcoin briefly dipped under $65,000 and stocks fell on renewed US-Iran hostilities—though the week still closed in the green.
